verdict.rationale: Ultrametric explicitly runs no model of its own; insights are produced by the user's own agent. It supplies the structure for that work: guides like `understand` (company profile) and `assess` (a four-dimension AI-readiness assessment with rubric and result schema), plus stored records where actions can be marked 'proposed'. So AI-generated assessments and suggestions about your company are possible, but only through your external agent host, not inside the product itself. missing for 10: native in-product AI insight generation, evidence of insights computed from user data rather than templates, hands-on corroboration of an insight or suggestion workflow with real data.
